question: Should Slack event delivery reject every non-global private-network target by default, while retaining only the explicit loopback testing exception?
rationale: The stricter default matches Slack's public HTTP endpoint model and strengthens SSRF protection, but it intentionally removes an existing private-LAN callback capability and therefore requires maintainer ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the strict default
options.body: Reject private and non-global targets by default, preserve explicit loopback testing, and document the compatibility change.

options.title: Preserve legacy private targets
options.body: Keep private-network delivery available by default or behind an explicit opt-in policy, accepting a broader outbound security boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep the strict default
recommendation.body: Reject private and non-global targets by default, preserve explicit loopback testing, and document the compatibility change.
